DaMENSCH Presents Judge Me If You Can | Episode 15

Welcome to Judge Me If You Can where Aashish Solanki, Chirag Panjwani & Raunaq Rajani judge a complete stranger using nothing but vibes. 
You could debate, overthink, and still end up WILDLY wrong. 
The stranger already knows all the answers; the panel tries their best. And every reveal is funnier and more unhinged than the last.
CAN YOU JUDGE THE RIGHT ANSWER BEFORE THE PANEL?
